qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Near-insurmountable switching costs in core banking software (SilverLake, CIF 20/20, Symitar/Episys) serving as the operational central nervous system for ~1,650+ US community banks and credit unions. Core replacements entail 18-24 month operational upheaval and high regulatory risk, producing 98-99% annual client retention with zero voluntary churn. Pricing power demonstrated by multi-year contracts with CPI escalation clauses and high-margin digital module upsells. 10-year GAAP ROIC has consistently ranged between 20% and 26% (median 22.7%), with tangible operating ROIC near 40%. Primary erosion risks are secular community bank M&A consolidation and long-term cloud-native core entrants, offset by expanding account volumes and new credit union core wins.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Quintessential core banking and payment processing toll booth for US regional banks and credit unions with 98-99% retention. Insulated across all 5 macrotrends: charges per transaction/account rather than vulnerable SaaS seats, 100% US domestic focus, asset-light, and virtually debt-free ($40M debt vs $635M EBIT). FCF conversion exceeds 120% of net income with a pristine balance sheet. [5-10Y g: transaction volume 2.5% + digital cross-sell 2.5% + price indexation 1.5% - bank consolidation attrition drag 1.0% + net buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year track record of rock-solid compounding: sales grew from $1.43B (FY16) to $2.54B (FY25), EBIT expanded from $341.7M to $635.0M, and Owner EPS compounded at 7.8% from $3.03 to $6.98 (peak FY25). 10-year GAAP ROIC never fell below 20% (median 22.72%, tangible operating ROIC 39.5%). Owner FCF conversion averaged 121% of GAAP net income over multiple cycles with low capex ($67M capex vs $762M OCF in FY25). Minimal debt ($40M long-term debt vs $503M net income and $12M cash), zero reliance on capital markets, conservative accounting with low SBC (<1.5% of revenue), and disciplined stewardship under David Foss and Greg Adelson.
